gen-eater-gf-mukta: Eater brings a dark, aggressive snarl, its wide-spaced letters carrying thin strokes beside moderately weighty stems. Mukta follows in clean sans-serif, tall-bodied and quiet, which is the pair's strongest quality: menace up top, restraint below.
gen-eater-gf-mukta-mahee: Mukta Mahee is chunky and approachable, with tall lowercase letters that fill each line generously. Mukta Mahee would swallow Eater if the body were set large, since the heading's short ascenders and wide gaps need the size to hold their ground.
gen-eater-gf-mukta-malar: Thin strokes with no hairlines sit beside moderately weighty stems in Eater, giving it a dark, aggressive bite. And Mukta Malar, a neutral sans with compressed ascenders, keeps the text tucked low and approachable underneath.
gen-eater-gf-mukta-vaani: Mukta Vaani reads contemporary and neutral, with a high-waisted lowercase. Under Eater's dark, curve-heavy display letters, a long passage would feel steady and unfussy, the body simply getting on with the job while the heading growls above.
gen-eater-gf-narnoor: Narnoor has short ascenders above big bowls, a professional plain sans with a neutral face. Shrink Eater and its stone-carved heft fades.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-display: Dark and snarling up top, with a big, tall middle zone in every word below. Noto Sans Display stays approachable.
gen-eater-gf-play: Eater's wide-spaced letters and short ascenders give it a dark, aggressive look that grabs attention at once, while Play sits underneath with little height difference between cases. Eater snarls, Play keeps order.
gen-eater-gf-port-lligat-sans: Dark, spiky and a bit menacing, this heading leads. Make Eater small and its stroke weights, which differ just enough to feel alive, get lost beside Port Lligat Sans, whose bowls stay open on one side and whose characters pack in tight.
gen-eater-gf-ramabhadra: Eater's wide letter gaps give it a dark, aggressive stance. Ramabhadra answers with a prominent x-height in plain sans, clean and professional, so the snarl up top gets a body that simply speaks clearly.
gen-eater-gf-rambla: Hairlines barely lighter than the stems give Eater a dark, aggressive edge. Rambla, a clean plain sans whose small letters stand almost as tall as capitals, makes the pair's strongest quality its sharp split in mood.
